title: Die-Cut Sticker Sheet
prompt: A die-cut sticker sheet for Ongea Pesa on a neutral light surface, top-down. A set of premium glossy vinyl stickers with white die-cut borders: (1) the orbital emblem icon, (2) a rounded pill that says 'SPEAK. SEND. DONE.', (3) the 'ONGEA PESA' wordmark lockup, (4) a small green-to-cyan waveform stripe, (5) a circular badge 'The bank that listens', (6) a tiny 'by NSAIT' chip in violet-to-blue. All in the teal/cyan/green palette on dark or white sticker bodies, cohesive, playful but premium, perfectly spelled, realistic glossy vinyl with subtle highlights.
negative_prompt: purple emblem, microphone clipart, dollar sign, messy overlap, lots of text, misspelling, neon, low-res, distorted text
notes: Launch-event swag. Keep each sticker readable as a standalone cut.
